title: Guide filters
notes: TV guide: choose any channel group from a list (also changes the group in Live TV)

title: Built for very large playlists
notes: Uses far less memory with hundreds of thousands of titles
New 'Preparing your library' step so the loading screen never looks stuck at 100%
Shows 'Opening your saved library' when starting from the saved copy

title: Faster first load
notes: Large playlists load about twice as fast: each list is now read only once

title: Reliable loading, progress, and one-click updates
notes: Fixed: the app could close while loading very large playlists
New loading screen shows each step, megabytes downloaded and item counts
Each section loads on its own, so one failing list no longer stops the rest
Updates: the app checks for new versions and installs them with one click
Diagnostics page with an activity log you can open on your phone
If the app ever closes unexpectedly, the error is shown on the next launch

title: First release
notes: Live TV with channel groups, logos, live preview and now/next info
Favorites: hold OK on any channel, movie or series
TV guide grid with a live 'now' line
Movies and Series with resume, start over and next episode
Search across channels, movies and series
Set up from your phone by scanning a QR code
